decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - The approved extension, outbuildings and boundary walls shall be externally rendered white and their roofs be modified as shown on drawings 1364-01/FP revision A, 1364-02/FP revision A, and 1364-03/FP within three months from the date of this approval to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - The extension and outbuilding hereby approved shall only be used for storage purposes ancillary to No 12 Spring Grove Road and shall not be used separately for residential, retail, business, office or industrial use.
description: Retrospective application for the retention of an existing single storey rear extension and single storey detached outbuildings for ancillary storage use, proposed alterations to their roofs, and retention of boundary walls.
